description.zh:
待解除关联的全球加速实例ID。最多支持输入50个全球加速ID。

为空时默认删除指定加速域名下所有关联关系。
description.en:
The ID of the GA instance to be disassociated. You can specify up to 50 IDs.

If you leave this parameter empty, all GA instances associated with the specified domain name are disassociated.

description.zh: 指定待解除关联的加速域名。
description.en: The accelerated domain name to be disassociated.

description.zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：**cn-hangzhou**。
description.en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

descriptions.zh: **DeleteDomainAcceleratorRelation**接口不支持在同一个账号下并发删除加速域名与全球加速实例的关联关系。
descriptions.en: You cannot call the **DeleteDomainAcceleratorRelation** operation again by using the same Alibaba Cloud account before the previous operation is complete.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga delete-domain-accelerator-relation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-ids ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --domain www.example.com --region cn-hangzhou
